name: 男主角
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept character redesign. Image1 is the user's approved unified STYLE AND COMPACT PROPORTION sample. Image2 is the previous identity/theme reference, NOT a costume to trace. Redesign the named subject into a distinctive new Chinese game character design using the direction below. Keep recognizable identity/theme, gender/age, palette and key props but intentionally refresh costume tailoring, silhouette rhythm, hair shape and personality-specific pose. Never clone the female blade sample's red outfit/face/hair across the cast. Match image1's bold controlled contours, coherent large gem-icon handpainted planes, 2-4 simple material shadows, graphic cartoon eyes with one small highlight max, no fragmented triangle mosaic, realistic eyes or 3D gloss. Humans approximately the SAME compact crown-to-sole head/body ratio as image1 (about four heads excluding hair/hats), retaining reasonable lean/stocky identity differences, no long-legged six-head fashion proportions. All women clearly adult, attractive natural full feminine curves and tailored garments but agile rather than heavy/barrel-thick; men retain distinct age/physique. Faces and bodies three-quarter facing SCREEN LEFT. Mild dynamic weight shift, two anatomically coherent separate legs and both feet readable, no parallel stiff pose or hidden extra leg. Props and hands structurally correct. Entire single full-body subject and ALL props safely inside a square canvas with 8% margins. Plain warm ivory #F4EFDF background, no shadows/scene/text/panels/extra people. Strong broad shape contrast, detail concentrated in only one or two zones. SPECIFIC DESIGN: 男主角：年轻成年男性，坚毅亲和的竹篓旅人。保留棕褐灰蓝竹黄识别色、黑色小髻、竹篓与圆编织水壶。重新设计短款棕色无对称斜襟外衣、灰蓝内层、窄腰带、束口旅裤与绑腿，衣摆只有少数斜切大片。图形方向为稳定上窄下宽三角与短折线，干练而非华丽，手握肩带、另一手松垂，轻微前进重心。不同于女刀客的长马尾和长开衩裙。
